mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPI YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO MoM > 1%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 3%, the combination signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE signals a tightening labor market with increased wage pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of Industrial Production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average suggests strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
